description:
Morning Dopamine Music | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours for a Feel-Good Start

Before the phone and before the list, give the morning a few slow minutes and some light.

This bright Indian sitar music is designed to give your morning a natural lift: an open, unhurried melody that wakes you gently and leaves you feeling good, no scrolling required.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of sitar with soft tabla, light and steady, with no vocals.

▶ Keep the morning bright — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for waking up, a slow breakfast, tea or coffee by the window, morning stretches, yoga, journaling, getting ready, a calm commute, or easing into work in a good mood.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar with soft tabla
Raga: Alhaiya Bilawal (a bright, open morning raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Warm, light, quietly confident
Atmosphere: First sun through an open window, a warm cup, a fresh day
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as you get out of bed and let it run through your first hour. Open a window, take a few slow breaths and let the long sitar notes set an easy pace.
